svg.aria-label: Lint: Spectral checks names, security and size limits. A selftest proves that each rule fires. Breaking: oasdiff on the APIs, eventcompat on the events, both against the PR base. Selftest: A fixture PR renames a required field. CI expects the gate to fail on it. Drift: CI generates the clients again and fails when the committed code differs
